en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a formal rose garden with curving gravel paths, flower beds, and rows of young rose trees. In the background stands an ornate open pavilion or music gazebo with a red roof and decorative trim, surrounded by tall leafy trees. A wooden bench is visible on the right side. The scene is tranquil and park-like, with printed red text at the top identifying the place.
